pbr_wood_floor.notes: 4 boards across (grain along U/x), staggered butt joints, knots, per-board tint, wear. Gaps dark in albedo and rough=1.

pbr_wood_pine.notes: light pine tongue-and-groove, 4 boards per tile, grain along U/x, V-grooves, a few knots.

pbr_wood_oak.notes: medium oak, fine grain along U/x with pores, satin roughness ~0.45.

pbr_wood_dark.notes: dark stained hand-hewn beam; grain along U/x, adze scoops across grain, small cracks.

pbr_plaster.notes: warm off-white lime plaster, mottling, hairline cracks, fine grain pits.

pbr_fabric_linen.notes: natural linen plain weave, 56 threads/tile (stylised coarse), slubs. Light neutral - tintable.

pbr_fabric_wool.notes: oatmeal knit (stockinette), 12 x 15 stitches per tile. Light neutral - tintable.

pbr_fabric_burlap.notes: jute hessian, 18 threads/tile, open weave gaps, dark in gaps.

pbr_leather.notes: worn brown leather: pebbled grain, soft creases, pores, wear patches.

pbr_rug_braided.notes: 4 straight braided rag cords per tile (U/x direction), 8 lobes per cord, multicolour muted.

pbr_iron.notes: dark cast iron, albedo ~0.24 grey (use metalness ~1), pitted, sand-cast grain, faint rust specks.

pbr_brass_copper.notes: brushed copper/brass, brushing along U/x, tarnish patches; roughness 0.3-0.55 (use metalness ~1).

pbr_ceramic.notes: off-white glazed earthenware, fine crazing, glossy roughness ~0.2; 256 px.

pbr_stone_fireplace.notes: fieldstone masonry ~5x4 stones with mortar joints, soot darkening.

pbr_paper.notes: aged cream paper, fibres, mottling, faint foxing; 256 px.

pbr_book_cloth.notes: burgundy cloth weave with embossed diamond lattice; mid-tone, tint-friendly.

pbr_wicker.notes: flat reed strips plain weave, 8 per tile, fibrous streaks.

pbr_glass_dirty.notes: optional: near-white albedo; smudges/dust encoded mainly in roughness (0.06 clean to ~0.4); 256 px.
